blocks.heading: Secure AI use at enterprise scale

blocks.text: AI is everywhere today—embedded in popular GenAI & SaaS apps, agents, and developer tools. This rapid proliferation introduces significant risks. Traditional firewalls lack the ability to secure AI environments, and emerging point solutions fall short of addressing risks at enterprise scale.
Zscaler delivers zero trust access controls, content moderation, and robust guardrails to help your business stay secure while accelerating AI adoption.
